name: Famine
summary: Risk-of-famine alerts for Somalia and Sudan; no current IPC Phase 5 confirmed
state: The 2026 Global Report on Food Crises (24 Apr) confirmed famine conditions in Gaza and Sudan during 2025. FEWS NET (6 Oct) flags a risk of famine in southern Somalia if El Niño floods are extreme, and drought threatens Sudan and South Sudan. No current IPC Phase 5 classification was confirmed as of 2 Nov.
for_you: Humanitarian agencies report record funding gaps; reputable appeals include WFP and UNICEF.

sources.title: Newscord — Global Report on Food Crises 2026: famine confirmed in Gaza Strip and Sudan
FEWS NET — 2026–2027 El Niño food security impacts

why: Famine is the most extreme humanitarian failure, almost always man-made by conflict.
drivers: War, sieges, aid access, harvest failure, funding cuts.

rubric.alert: Famine (IPC Phase 5) confirmed in at least one area.
rubric.watch: IPC Phase 5 projected or 'risk of famine' alerts.
rubric.normal: No IPC Phase 5 (Famine) classifications or projections.
